topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The package arrived on a morning much like any other, the kind where the sun pushes through the blinds with a gentle insistence. There was no anunciating fanfare, just the quiet thud of it on my doorstep. Inside, layers of soft paper swirled like fallen leaves, and beneath them, a book. Not any book, but the very one I recommended years ago, its pages now worn, the cover slightly frayed. Bound within, a note, simple and sincere. It spoke of paths taken, choices made, and a light that shone brighter because of words shared in a classroom long ago. The book’s weight in my hands felt like a legacy, an echo of days spent nurturing minds. It was a reminder that sometimes, the seeds we sow take root in the most unexpected ways.
